oof.batch_fit_policy: eight chronological batches; batch k predicts the next fixed 10000-row interval using one model fit at origin[k] and its admissible prefix; no later origin label can enter an earlier batch
oof.train_window_rule: expanding eligible prefix with no cap
oof.train_prefix_rule: target_end <= origin - purge_bars and label row < origin
oof.target_mask_rule: all target bars t+1..t+h must have spot_bar_observed=true, a finite return, and contiguous 15m timestamps; future funding/mark masks do not invalidate a return label
oof.feature_scaling: fit on eligible prefix rows u < origin only; no global or split-wide fit
oof.early_rows: remain false/NaN; no zero fill, interpolation, or row compaction
oof.same_row_future_perturbation: must not change that row's OOF state; it may change later admissible prefixes

availability.origin_context_row_rule: decision origin/context row requires spot_bar_observed, funding_rate_available, mark_close_available, and all 17 model features finite
availability.outcome_label_row_rule: each target bar t+1..t+h requires spot_bar_observed, a finite return, and contiguous 15m adjacency; funding_rate_available and mark_close_available are not required for a return label
availability.window_rule: one false/missing/non-contiguous required row invalidates the corresponding context or target window; required masks are not interchangeable
availability.gap_policy: retain original timestamps and false masks; never sort, compress, interpolate, or convert missing to observed zero

action_contract.execution_rule: decision t -> full fill t+1 -> fixed position returns t+1..t+4
action_contract.reoptimization_rule: no reoptimization inside a four-bar commitment; next decision at t+4 and next fill at t+5
action_contract.partial_fill_policy: unsupported; record N/A and do not repair
action_contract.utility_o2_o3: same four-bar pathwise utility with calibrated joint scenarios; no independent marginal synthesis
action_contract.oracle_reference: same feasible action set and trajectory using realized four-bar return path; report-only upper bound
action_contract.student_or_policy_inventory: previous realized policy position from the same replay, never teacher or hindsight inventory
action_contract.clairvoyant_state_policy: at every scored origin, use the same current inventory p_{t-1} carried by the forecast policy; never source inventory from hindsight, U0 global DP, or a teacher trajectory
action_contract.action_agreement_definition: compare forecast-optimal next position and realized four-bar one-block optimal next position from the same p_{t-1} and feasible action set
action_contract.regret_definition: realized best four-bar utility minus chosen utility from the same p_{t-1}; opportunity denominator is realized clairvoyant utility minus hold utility from that same p_{t-1}
action_contract.inventory_transition_rule: only the chosen policy action advances that policy's p_{t-1} to the next block; clairvoyant/U0 paths never feed back into policy inventory
action_contract.u0_global_dp_role: report-only upper bound; it cannot define per-row clairvoyant state, action agreement, regret, or policy inventory

action_execution_contract_reference.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes with sorted keys and compact separators

cost_mode_contracts.derivation: geometry, masks, timing, and inventory semantics are copied from the canonical cost-on JSON; only spread_bps, slippage_bps, fee_rate, and transition_cost_rate are deterministically replaced with zero for cost-off

off.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes with sorted keys and compact separators

on.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes with sorted keys and compact separators

v4_load_contract.cache_local_metadata_policy: read only when present; echo cache-local file SHA, source-provenance digest, schema digest, content digests, and row counts separately; never pass cache-local metadata as metadata_path or replace the frozen metadata
v4_load_contract.cache_local_frozen_difference_policy: do not hide any local-versus-frozen difference; content/schema/cache-tag/row-count mismatch blocks S3, while a source-provenance revision difference is retained in the artifact for explicit disposition before promotion

gap_scoring_semantics.feature_or_context_gap: decision origin is ineligible for forecast and action-agreement scoring; retain timestamp and false mask; do not synthesize a new action
gap_scoring_semantics.active_commitment_feature_gap: after a valid fill, hold the committed position and include the four-bar PnL if its outcome window is complete; do not reoptimize or impute a feature
gap_scoring_semantics.execution_gap: fill/observation skip follows execution_skip_policy=hold_commitment, is recorded, and is not treated as a new action
gap_scoring_semantics.outcome_gap: any missing/non-finite/non-contiguous spot return in t+1..t+4 excludes the complete block from PnL, utility, regret, agreement, and all benchmarks; funding/mark gaps alone do not
gap_scoring_semantics.pnl_scored_mask: valid_fill_or_active_hold_commitment AND four_bar_outcome_complete; an active feature gap is scored as the committed hold

on.round_trip_rule: charge the same one-way transition rule on each position change

zero_return.continuous_prediction: zero cumulative return for every horizon h
zero_return.action_role: fixed non-learned comparator; h4 action uses the same Q mapper

persistence_last_observed.continuous_prediction: h * return[t] where return[t] is the last observed one-bar log return at decision t
persistence_last_observed.binary_prediction: clip(1 - 1e-6, 1e-6) for nonnegative return[t], otherwise clip(1e-6)
persistence_last_observed.action_role: fixed non-learned comparator; h4 action uses the same Q mapper

ridge.action_role: sole learned h4 action mapper; no probability-to-return conversion

logistic.action_role: binary proper-score diagnostic only; action utility is N/A

metrics.reporting_rule: report point estimate, denominator, and interval; undefined metrics are N/A and cannot promote

primary_metric_formulas.forecast_mse_skill: 1 - MSE(model, y_h4) / MSE(zero_return, y_h4), evaluated on the same complete-target rows
primary_metric_formulas.normalized_action_regret: per seed and bootstrap replicate, sum(action_regret_vs_clairvoyant) / sum(clairvoyant_net_utility - hold_net_utility) using the same current inventory p_{t-1} for every action; require a strictly positive aggregate opportunity denominator
primary_metric_formulas.s2_timing_net_utility_delta: mean over scored rows of [Ridge policy net utility - hold net utility] at each SNR level, with the policy's own carried p_{t-1}
primary_metric_formulas.s3_mse_skill_difference_in_differences: skill(injected Ridge vs injected zero) - skill(control Ridge vs control zero), where skill(A vs B)=1-MSE(A)/MSE(B), on identical timestamps
primary_metric_formulas.s3_timing_net_utility_difference_in_diff: [Ridge-minus-hold net utility]_injected - [Ridge-minus-hold net utility]_control using each pair's same carried p_{t-1} and identical scored timestamps
primary_metric_formulas.s2_shared_randomness: S2 high, medium, and low use identical base features, return-noise draws, sidecar gap masks, seeds, and row support; only beta changes

gates.multiplicity_method: Holm-Bonferroni over the fixed primary comparison family

block_bootstrap.resampling_unit: contiguous blocks within each seed/split; same sampled indices for candidate and paired baseline
block_bootstrap.paired_delta_formula: d_i = candidate_i - baseline_i on the same scored row; each replicate resamples contiguous blocks of d_i and reports mean(d_i)
block_bootstrap.seed_aggregation: for synthetic comparisons, independently resample blocks within each seed and compute that seed's mean; aggregate the ten seed means with equal 1/10 weight, never row-count weighting; S3 is one timestamp stratum
block_bootstrap.interval_formula: two-sided percentile interval [quantile_0.025, quantile_0.975] for each fixed block length over exactly 2000 fixed-seed replicates; intervals are diagnostic only
block_bootstrap.sensitivity_conservative_rule: for each comparison, raw_p = max(p_block_length_8, p_block_length_16, p_block_length_32); use this intersection-union conservative p as the sole input to Holm; each block-length interval remains diagnostic
block_bootstrap.utility_gate: non-S0 utility gates use the Holm-adjusted one-sided p from raw_p; no gate is formed by requiring an unadjusted lower bound at all block lengths

holm.p_value_formula: for favorable positive contrast q_i, p_L=(1 + count_b(T_b,L <= 0))/(B+1); for favorable negative contrast q_i, p_L=(1 + count_b(T_b,L >= 0))/(B+1), with B=2000 for each L in {8,16,32}, then raw_p=max(p_8,p_16,p_32)
holm.direction_transform: transform each contrast so favorable evidence is positive before applying the positive-tail formula; high_le_medium uses medium_minus_high, medium_le_low uses low_minus_medium, and null non_positive uses the positive-edge tail
holm.ordering: sort raw p-values ascending; break exact ties by comparison_id lexicographic order
holm.step_down: with sorted rank r in 1..m, reject rank r iff every rank j<=r satisfies p_(j) <= familywise_alpha/(m-j+1); stop at the first failure; adjusted_p_(r)=min(1,max_{j<=r}((m-j+1)*p_(j)))
holm.gate_rule: a positive/negative primary comparison passes only when its direction is favorable and its Holm step-down adjusted p <= 0.05; S0 non_positive is a safety gate requiring a Holm-rank-adjusted positive-direction lower bound <= 0 at every L in {8,16,32}, and positive-edge Holm rejection=false
holm.s0_adjusted_lower_bound: after conservative raw_p ordering assigns rank r, alpha_r=familywise_alpha/(family_size-r+1); for each L, lower_bound_L is quantile_alpha_r(T_b,L) for the positive-edge contrast, and S0 passes only when every lower_bound_L <= 0
holm.ci_role: two-sided percentile intervals at L in {8,16,32} are fixed reporting diagnostics; only conservative raw_p=max(p_8,p_16,p_32) enters Holm for non-S0 contrasts, with no post-output choice of tail or block length

wilson.formula: phat=x/n; center=(phat+z^2/(2n))/(1+z^2/n); half=z*sqrt(phat*(1-phat)/n+z^2/(4n^2))/(1+z^2/n); interval=[center-half,center+half]; no normal approximation
wilson.action_agreement_gate: high-SNR S1/S2 point agreement >= 0.90 on every seed and pooled Wilson lower bound >= 0.90
wilson.coverage_gate: all required coverage fractions must meet their fixed scenario threshold

monotonicity.scope: S2 high, medium, low SNR, evaluated on the same seed and row support
monotonicity.aggregation: within each seed compute the metric on its common support, then compare the ten seed metrics with equal 1/10 weight; block bootstrap also aggregates ten seed means equally (S3 has one timestamp stratum)
monotonicity.decision_formula: for an ordered triple (high,medium,low), pass iff each adjacent inequality holds after adding tie_tolerance to the right-hand side for <= or subtracting it for >=
monotonicity.violation_policy: record violation and fail the monotonicity gate; no post-output tuning or scenario deletion

zero_signal.scope: S0 for every fixed model and cost mode
zero_signal.promotion_rule: no candidate may pass the positive utility or high-agreement gate; any apparent pass is a preregistration/implementation failure
zero_signal.utility_rule: for each L in {8,16,32}, the Holm-rank-adjusted positive-direction lower percentile for candidate-minus-hold net utility must be <= 0 and the positive-edge Holm rejection must be false; this is a safety gate, not evidence that the true edge is negative
zero_signal.agreement_rule: pooled Wilson lower bound must remain below 0.90

high_snr_recovery.utility_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p from conservative raw_p <= 0.05 and favorable point delta > 0 for OOF-minus-hold net utility under cost-on; cost-off is a paired diagnostic
high_snr_recovery.clairvoyant_rule: clairvoyant action value must exceed OOF action value on the same support; this is an upper-bound sanity check, not a selection target

s3_injected_signal.scope: injected BTC versus same-row zero-injection parent control
s3_injected_signal.utility_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p from conservative raw_p <= 0.05 and favorable point delta > 0 for the injected-control timing net-utility difference-in-differences
s3_injected_signal.forecast_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p from conservative raw_p <= 0.05 and favorable point delta > 0 for h4 MSE-skill difference-in-differences
s3_injected_signal.prefix_invariance_rule: future perturbation after origin cannot alter any earlier OOF prediction, mask, or fitted-prefix digest

trial_registry.hash_method: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JSONL bytes
trial_registry.primary_record_rule: every record has primary=true; no result may add, remove, reorder, or relabel a record

primary_comparison_registry.hash_method: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 JSONL bytes
primary_comparison_registry.family_size_rule: count of JSONL records with primary=true; this count is the sole Holm-Bonferroni family size

runner_contract.outer_test_rows: report-only; never tune, select, or revise thresholds
runner_contract.cost_contract_consistency: optimizer, teacher, student replay, U0, Q, and Backtest must all verify the mode-specific contract hash before scoring; a missing or mismatched hash fails closed
runner_contract.inventory_consistency: agreement and regret use each forecast policy's own carried p_{t-1}; U0/global hindsight inventory cannot enter row scoring or update policy state

synthetic_contract.observed_features_formula: x[t,0] = z[t]; x[t,j] = N(0,1) for j=1..16, all generated before target
synthetic_contract.target_formula: y[t,h] = sum(r[t+1:t+h+1]) for h in common.forecast_horizons
synthetic_contract.scenario_seed_policy: draw z, all 16 noise features, return-noise epsilon, and availability starts once per seed; reuse those arrays for S0, S1, S2-high, S2-medium, and S2-low, changing only beta
synthetic_contract.future_perturbation_test: add a fixed delta to returns strictly after an origin's target_end and assert all earlier predictions/masks are unchanged

mask_only_sanity.method: availability/context/target mask counting only with all three sources in context and spot-only target labels; no model fit or outcome inspection
mask_only_sanity.reported_value_role: conservative fixed reference from the preregistration mask-only derivation

S0.name: zero_signal
S0.hypothesis: fixed models and the action mapper do not manufacture a timing edge from noise
S0.randomness_role: uses the shared synthetic base stream; beta=0 is the only scenario mutation

S1.name: known_high_snr_dgp
S1.hypothesis: a known causal observable state is recovered under the complete timing and action contract
S1.randomness_role: uses the shared synthetic base stream; beta is the only return-process mutation

S2.name: monotonic_snr
S2.hypothesis: forecast skill, action agreement, and utility degrade monotonically as only SNR decreases
S2.randomness_role: one shared base stream per seed for all three levels; beta is the only mutation

S3.name: semi_synthetic_btc_observable_injection
S3.hypothesis: a known signal injected through an existing causal BTC feature is recovered under real v4 gaps, volatility, and costs

signal.observable_at: decision timestamp t after the close of bar t
signal.prefix_scaling_formula: z[t] = (close_ret[t] - mean(close_ret[u] for eligible u<t)) / max(std(close_ret[u] for eligible u<t), 1e-12)
signal.apply_only_to: eligible decision origins; invalid/gapped rows remain false and are not repaired
signal.hidden_state_policy: no generated z or latent column may be passed to the model; z is recomputable from the named v4 feature and prefix fit record

S3.v4_row_alignment: use feature-body rows in their original order; sidecar lookup is exact timestamp membership; any non-15m adjacency or false sidecar value invalidates the complete window without compaction
S3.common_row_definition: decision origins whose 64-bar context has finite canonical 17 features and all three v4 availability masks true, and whose target window has finite spot returns with contiguous 15m timestamps; funding/mark masks are not required on future label bars
S3.common_row_index_definition: sorted raw feature-body indices with a complete 64-bar all-three-mask context and complete h16 spot-return target, after exact timestamp join; future funding/mark gaps alone do not remove a label
S3.excluded_common_schedule_origin_reason: the eighth synthetic-relative origin would fall inside the sealed 2023-01-01 outer-test range after timestamp alignment
S3.outer_report_fit_rule: single report-only fit using the admissible prefix before raw index 139568 and one prediction pass over raw [139568,173111); outer rows cannot tune, select, or change any development decision
S3.raw_index_boundary_note: the common schedule is resolved after timestamp join; raw body thirds are forbidden, and the final development batch is truncated at the 2023-01-01 outer-test boundary
S3.split_resolution: resolve each timestamp range against the immutable v4 body/sidecar join, preserve original row indices, and apply the common-row mask; never substitute raw body thirds
S3.origin_resolution: apply the common chronological origin schedule after the timestamp join; record each resolved timestamp and ordinal before fitting
S3.seed_policy: one deterministic S3 run; uncertainty comes from the fixed paired moving-block bootstrap rather than pseudo-replicate seeds
